== Summary ==
Lossless page extract from the complete official Set 8 PDF preserved by the Internet Archive [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005192157id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-8.pdf at 2021-10-05T19:21:57Z]. Extract page 1 is original page 1 (cover/header); extract page 2 is original page 6 (including Suppressive Fire and Walker Sighting); extract page 3 is original page 8 (including Luke's Blaster Pistol). Text, vector icons and embedded source images are preserved without rasterization or lossy image recompression. The full original has eight readable pages,91,586,923bytes and SHA-256 <code>7c9bcdab4cba33e1af1225c88cd3b0aa6e73839dd3e01658d33369b9f7391cde</code>; it exceeds the Wiki upload size limit and remains unchanged in the source archive. Exact first publication day unknown. Extract SHA-256 <code>63c1de368f84f7a863a8875db4c9c0918fd168caf79e8f77b2d27316bcd0c0b6</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
